external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The recipient of an invoice email who can view the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: An agent who works from the support office network and uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used by customer users, which handles invoices, customer records, payout bank details, PDF requests, payment pages and customer-user sessions.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether it also checks that the invoice belongs to the user's company. Nobody wrote down whether the billing app checks the user's role again when a request arrives. The billing app trusts its own company filter and receives all invoice edit fields.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time, reads the invoice from the tenant database and writes the PDF to the PDF bucket
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID the job carries.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console reachable from the support office network that lets a support agent open a billing-app session as any customer user.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself, and the database has no row-level security. The app connects with one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue holding PDF render jobs containing a company ID and an invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket where the PDF renderer writes PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies. Nobody recorded how the bucket is protected at rest.

data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name and bank details

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database's stated contents—company invoices, customer records and payout bank details—are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains invoices, customers and payout bank details, which are personal and financial records.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket's stated contents—invoice PDFs containing invoice and bank-detail information—are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the bucket stores rendered PDFs of invoices, and the payment page shows invoice and bank details.
